name: codex-docker-host
description: Codex in Docker host networking; replace the image and host paths and confirm host-network support on the execution target before registration
before_start: Confirm the image and mount paths, and verify that Docker host networking is supported and enabled on the execution target. Do not configure a proxy or published ports in host mode.
after_start: Complete any required harness authentication and check connectivity before normal work.
special_instructions: Host networking and proxy mode are exclusive. Do not change Docker networking settings without user approval.
